# Frozen UI prototype — do not edit

This is the throwaway prototype (React 18 + Tailwind 3, client-only, fake data) that
validated Reel's design before the real build. It is kept **frozen as a reference**:
the phase specs in [docs/phases/](../docs/phases/) say "port X from the prototype",
and comments across [app/src](../app/src) cite it as the source of a look or behavior.

The production app lives in [app/](../app). Nothing here runs in production, nothing
here gets dependency updates, and none of its code is imported anywhere.
